description: This is a C++ source file implementing the main logic for a WebRTC-based component in the Cuttlefish project. It sets up various configurations, handles control commands, manages streaming, and integrates multiple subsystems such as display, audio, and input handling.

classes.name: CfOperatorObserver
classes.description: Implements the OperatorObserver interface to handle registration, closure, and error events for WebRTC operator connections.

methods.name: CreateAudioServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new AudioServer instance with the duplicated audio server file descriptor.

methods.name: WebRtcComponent
methods.description: Defines a dependency injection component for WebRTC-related configuration.

methods.name: CreateConfirmationUIComponent
methods.description: Creates a component for the confirmation UI, binding necessary instances for display and input handling.

methods.name: ControlLoop
methods.description: Main control loop handling WebRTC commands such as start/stop recording and taking screenshots.

methods.name: CuttlefishMain
methods.description: Main entry point for the application, setting up configurations, subsystems, and starting the main event loop.
